status: Design candidate; no verified installer or deployed app
scope: Offline only; no physical device changes

architecture.os: Preserve stock kernel, radio and Wemo processes
architecture.relay: Prefer controlling stock local basicevent API from the on-device Matter process instead of taking over GPIO. Loopback endpoint and coexistence still need verification. No external bridge required.
architecture.startup: Candidate late-boot background launcher via rc.local overlay; demonstrated in 11420 source only, requires privileged filesystem access and verification on 11565. Never replace stock startup scripts.
architecture.first_execution: Only after obtaining a safe authorized execution method and examining memory/free space; stage a nonpersistent RAM trial with bounded resources, no automatic restart. No execution access currently established.

initial_install_access.verified: SSDP discovery, HTTP descriptions, basicevent relay control
initial_install_access.unverified: Shell, arbitrary safe file transfer, privileged startup configuration writes
rejected_shortcuts: Firmware update endpoint replaces firmware, not an app installer
HTTP rules/icon POST whitelist does not permit arbitrary executable/startup paths
StoreRules and DecodeRuleDbData are rule database paths; no supported app deployment interface established
Do not use crash or command-injection probes on device to discover recovery

remote_app_update_design.transport: Authenticated LAN update session from a temporarily connected PC; no permanent external server required
remote_app_update_design.validation: Signed application manifest and payload; board/ABI/version checks; reject incomplete or oversized transfer before activation
remote_app_update_design.staging: Stage in RAM if measured RAM permits; keep previous persistent version intact until verified candidate is safely committed
remote_app_update_design.activation: Bounded trial and health check of stock Wi-Fi/control and Matter; atomic version selection on one filesystem; preserve commissioning data with version-aware migrations
remote_app_update_design.rollback: Stock-independent small supervisor can disable or revert a failed Matter process while Linux remains healthy; this is application rollback, not recovery from corrupted filesystem/kernel/radio
remote_app_update_design.storage_requirement: Need measured room for installed app, previous version or other verified revert strategy, supervisor, Matter state, and filesystem reserve. Current known partition budget does not establish this capacity.

storage.caveat: These are prior build and 11420 layout measurements; live free space unknown. No spare firmware slot or identity partition is allocated to this design.

acceptance_before_persistence: Verified execution and file-copy method on installed version
Measured available RAM and persistent storage
Stock services remain functional when Matter crashes/hangs or payload is missing/corrupt
Recovery from interrupted application update demonstrated without replacing OS
Safe removal/disable procedure through surviving stock access
No bootloader, raw partition, kernel or vendor Wi-Fi changes

# Put your custom commands here that should be executed once

exit 0

#!/bin/sh

while true; do
    /sbin/natClient &>/dev/console &
    /sbin/wemoApp -webdir /tmp/Belkin_settings/ &>/dev/console
    if [ -e /tmp/rebooting ]; then
	    exit
    fi
    killall natClient
    killall wemoApp
    if [ "$(nvram get SAVE_MULTIPLE_LOGS)" = "{ NULL String }" -o "$(nvram get SAVE_MULTIPLE_LOGS)" = "" ]; then
	    rm -f /tmp/messages-*
    fi
    cp /var/log/messages /tmp/messages-$(date +%Y-%m-%d-%H:%M)
    sleep 2
done
